name: org.forgerock.android.auth.InitProvider
description: ForgeRock's Android authentication SDK starts this Provider automatically when the app process opens. It keeps the app context and tracks the active screen so sign-in, device binding, and other interactive authentication steps can use the right Activity.
disableEffect: If disabled, ForgeRock authentication steps that need the app context or current Activity can fail, including device binding and interactive sign-in.
